verses.en: In the beginning, our Heavenly Father created the heavens and the earth.
verses.tr: Ku lubereberye, Kitaffe ow'omu ggulu yatonda eggulu n'ensi.

verses.en: The earth was formless and empty; darkness lay over the deep's surface, and the Spirit of our Father was hovering over the waters' surface.
verses.tr: Kale ensi yali nga teriiko kabonero era nga njereere, ekizikiza nga kibisse ku maaso g'obuziba, n'Omwoyo gwa Kitaffe nga gwesuula ku maaso g'amazzi.

verses.en: Then our Father said, "Let there be light," and there was light.
verses.tr: Awo Kitaffe n'ayogera nti, "Wabeewo ekitangaala," ne wabaawo ekitangaala.

verses.en: He saw that the light was good, and he separated the light from the darkness.
verses.tr: N'alaba ng'ekitangaala kirungi, n'ayawula ekitangaala n'ekizikiza.

verses.en: He called the light "day" and called the darkness "night." There was evening, and there was morning—the first day.
verses.tr: Ekitangaala n'akituuma "emisana," n'ekizikiza n'akituuma "ekiro." Ne wabaawo akawungeezi, ne wabaawo enkya—olunaku olubereberye.

verses.en: And our Father said, "Let there be an expanse between the waters to separate water from water."
verses.tr: Era Kitaffe n'ayogera nti, "Wabeewo ebbanga wakati w'amazzi okwawula amazzi ku mazzi."

verses.en: He made the expanse and separated the water under it from the water above it. And it was so.
verses.tr: Awo n'akola ebbanga, n'ayawula amazzi agaali wansi w'ebbanga ku amazzi agaali waggulu waalyo. Ne kiba bwe kityo.

verses.en: He called the expanse "sky." So there was evening, and there was morning—the second day.
verses.tr: Ebbanga n'alituuma "eggulu." Awo ne wabaawo akawungeezi, ne wabaawo enkya—olunaku olwokubiri.

verses.en: Then our Father said, "Let the water under the sky be gathered to one place, and let dry ground appear." And it was so.
verses.tr: Awo Kitaffe n'ayogera nti, "Amazzi agali wansi w'eggulu gakuŋŋaanyizibwe mu kifo kimu, era olukalu lulabike." Ne kiba bwe kityo.

verses.en: He named the dry ground "land," the gathered waters "seas." And he saw it was good.
verses.tr: Olukalu n'alutuuma "ettaka," n'amazzi agaakuŋŋaanyizibwa n'agatuuma "ennyanja." N'alaba nga kirungi.

verses.en: Then he said, "Let the land grow vegetation: seed-bearing plants, fruit trees bearing fruit with seed in it, after its kind." And it was so.
verses.tr: Awo n'ayogera nti, "Ettaka limeze ebimera: ebimera ebibala ensigo n'emiti egibala ebibala ebirimu ensigo, buli kimu ng'ekika kyakyo bwe kiri." Ne kiba bwe kityo.

verses.en: The land produced vegetation—seed-bearing plants by kind, and trees bearing seed-bearing fruit by kind—and our Father saw that it was good.
verses.tr: Ettaka ne limeza ebimera: ebimera ebibala ensigo ng'ebika byabyo bwe biri n'emiti egibala ebibala ebirimu ensigo ng'ebika byabyo bwe biri. Kitaffe n'alaba nga kirungi.

verses.en: And there was evening, and there was morning—the third day.
verses.tr: Ne wabaawo akawungeezi, ne wabaawo enkya—olunaku olwokusatu.

verses.en: And our Father said, "Let there be lights in the sky's expanse to separate day from night, and serve as signs to mark seasons, days, and years,
verses.tr: Era Kitaffe n'ayogera nti, "Wabeewo ettaala mu bbanga ery'eggulu okwawula emisana n'ekiro, era zibeere obubonero okutegeeza ebiseera, ennaku, n'emyaka,"

verses.en: and let them be lights in the sky's expanse, to give light on the earth." And it was so.
verses.tr: "era zibeere ettaala mu bbanga ery'eggulu okwaka ku nsi." Ne kiba bwe kityo.

verses.en: Our Father made two great lights—the greater light to rule the day, the lesser light to rule the night. He also made the stars.
verses.tr: Kitaffe n'akola ettaala ennene bbiri: ettaala esinga obunene okufuga emisana n'ettaala entono okufuga ekiro. N'akola n'emmunyeenye.

verses.en: He set them in the expanse of the sky to give light on the earth,
verses.tr: N'azissa mu bbanga ery'eggulu okwaka ku nsi,

verses.en: to rule the day and the night, and to separate light from darkness. He saw it was good.
verses.tr: okufuga emisana n'ekiro, n'okwawula ekitangaala n'ekizikiza. N'alaba nga kirungi.

verses.en: So there was evening, and there was morning—the fourth day.
verses.tr: Awo ne wabaawo akawungeezi, ne wabaawo enkya—olunaku olwokuna.

verses.en: Then our Father said, "Let the water swarm with living creatures, and let birds fly above the earth, across the sky's expanse."
verses.tr: Awo Kitaffe n'ayogera nti, "Amazzi gajjule ebitonde ebiramu, n'ebinyonyi bibuukire waggulu w'ensi mu bbanga ery'eggulu."

verses.en: So he created the great sea creatures, every living creature that moves and swarms in the water by its kind, and every winged bird by its kind. And he saw it was good.
verses.tr: Awo n'atonda ebitonde eby'ennyanja ebinene na buli kitonde ekiramu ekitambula era ekijjula amazzi, buli kimu ng'ekika kyakyo bwe kiri, na buli kinyonyi eky'ebiwaawaatiro ng'ekika kyakyo bwe kiri. N'alaba nga kirungi.

verses.en: Our Father blessed them and said, "Be fruitful, multiply, fill the waters in the seas, and let birds multiply on earth."
verses.tr: Kitaffe n'abiwa omukisa n'ayogera nti, "Muzaale era mwale, mujjuze amazzi ag'omu nnyanja, n'ebinyonyi byaze ku nsi."

verses.en: And there was evening, and there was morning—the fifth day.
verses.tr: Ne wabaawo akawungeezi, ne wabaawo enkya—olunaku olwokutaano.

verses.en: And our Father said, "Let the land produce living creatures by kind: livestock, crawling creatures, and wild animals, each by kind." And it was so.
verses.tr: Era Kitaffe n'ayogera nti, "Ettaka limeze ebitonde ebiramu ng'ebika byabyo bwe biri: ente, ebitonde ebitambula ku ttaka, n'ensolo ez'omu nsiko, buli kimu ng'ekika kyakyo bwe kiri." Ne kiba bwe kityo.

verses.en: He made wild animals by their kind, livestock by their kind, and every creature crawling the ground by its kind. And he saw that it was good.
verses.tr: N'akola ensolo ez'omu nsiko ng'ebika byazo bwe biri, n'ente ng'ebika byazo bwe biri, n'ebitonde byonna ebitambula ku ttaka ng'ebika byabyo bwe biri. N'alaba nga kirungi.

verses.en: Then our Father said, "Let us make humanity in our image, in our likeness, to rule the fish of the sea, the birds of the sky, the livestock, all the earth, and every creature crawling on the ground."
verses.tr: Awo Kitaffe n'ayogera nti, "Tukole omuntu mu kifaananyi kyaffe, mu kibala kyaffe, balyoke bafuge eby'ennyanja ebya mu nnyanja n'ebinyonyi eby'omu ggulu, n'ente, n'ensi yonna, na buli kitonde ekitambula ku ttaka."

verses.en: So our Father created humanity in his own image; in the image of God he created them; male and female he created them.
verses.tr: Awo Kitaffe n'atonda omuntu mu kifaananyi kyabwe; mu kifaananyi kya Kitaffe, n'Omwana, n'Omwoyo Omutukuvu yabatonda; obusajja n'obukazi yabatonda.

verses.en: Our Father blessed them and said to them, "Be fruitful, multiply, fill the earth and subdue it. Rule the fish of the sea, the birds of the sky, and every living creature that moves on the earth."
verses.tr: Kitaffe n'abawa omukisa n'abagamba nti, "Muzaale era mwale; mujjuze ensi era mugifuge. Mufuge eby'ennyanja ebya mu nnyanja n'ebinyonyi eby'omu ggulu, na buli kitonde ekiramu ekitambula ku ttaka."

verses.en: Then he said, "I give you every seed-bearing plant across the whole earth, and every tree with seed-bearing fruit—they will be your food.
verses.tr: Awo n'ayogera nti, "Mbawa buli kimera ekibala ensigo ekiri ku nsi yonna na buli muti ogubala ebibala ebirimu ensigo. Binaaba byammwe okuba emmere.

verses.en: To every animal of the earth, every bird of the sky, everything crawling on the ground with breath of life, I give every green plant for food." And so it happened.
verses.tr: "Era eri ensolo zonna ez'oku nsi, n'ebinyonyi byonna eby'omu ggulu, na buli kitonde ekitambula ku ttaka—buli ekirina omukka gw'obulamu mu kyo—mbawa buli kimera ekibisi okuba emmere." Ne kiba bwe kityo.

verses.en: Our Father saw all he had made, and it was very good. So there was evening, and there was morning—the sixth day.
verses.tr: Kitaffe n'alaba byonna bye yali akoze, era nga birungi nnyo. Awo ne wabaawo akawungeezi, ne wabaawo enkya—olunaku olwomukaaga.

verses.en: Now there was a man of the Pharisees named Nicodemus, a ruler of the Jews.
verses.tr: Waaliwo omusajja ow'Abafalisaayo erinnya lye Nikodemo, omukulembeze w'Abayudaaya.

verses.en: This man came to Jesus at night and said, "Rabbi, we know you are a teacher who has come from our Father, for no one can do these signs you do unless our Father is with him."
verses.tr: Omusajja ono n'ajja eri Yesu ekiro n'amugamba nti, "Labbi, tumanyi nti oli muyigiriza eyava eri Kitaffe, kubanga tewali ayinza kukola bubonero buno bw'okola wabula nga Kitaffe ali naye."

verses.en: Jesus answered, "Truly, truly, I tell you: unless someone is born from above, he can't see the kingdom of our Father."
verses.tr: Yesu n'amuddamu nti, "Mazima ddala, mazima ddala, nkugamba nti, omuntu bw'atazaalibwa mulundi gwa kubiri tayinza kulaba bwakabaka bwa Kitaffe."

verses.en: Nicodemus asked, "How can a man be born when he's old? Can he enter his mother's womb again and be born?"
verses.tr: Nikodemo n'amugamba nti, "Omuntu ayinza atya okuzaalibwa ng'amaze okukula? Ayinza okuyingira omulundi ogwokubiri mu lubuto lwa nnyina n'azaalibwa?"

verses.en: Jesus answered, "Truly, truly, I tell you, unless one is born of water and the Holy Spirit, he can't enter our Father's kingdom.
verses.tr: Yesu n'addamu nti, "Mazima ddala, mazima ddala, nkugamba nti, omuntu bw'atazaalibwa mu mazzi ne mu Mwoyo Omutukuvu, tayinza kuyingira bwakabaka bwa Kitaffe."

verses.en: Born of the flesh is flesh, and born of the Holy Spirit is spirit.
verses.tr: Ekizaalibwa mu mubiri kiba mubiri, n'ekizaalibwa mu Mwoyo Omutukuvu kiba mwoyo.

verses.en: Don't be amazed that I said to you, 'You must be born from above.'
verses.tr: Toyitirira kwewuunya olw'okuba nkugambye nti, 'Kibagwanira okuzaalibwa omulundi ogwokubiri.'

verses.en: Wind blows where it wants; you hear its sound but don't know where it comes from or where it goes. So it is with everyone born of the Spirit."
verses.tr: Empewo ekunta gy'eyagala, era owulira eddoboozi lyayo, naye tomanyi gy'eva oba gy'egenda. Bwe kityo bwe kiri eri buli azaalibwa mu Mwoyo Omutukuvu.

verses.en: Nicodemus said to him, "How can these things be?"
verses.tr: Nikodemo n'amugamba nti, "Ebintu bino biyinza bitya okubaawo?"

verses.en: Jesus answered him, "Are you the teacher of Israel and yet you do not understand these things?
verses.tr: Yesu n'amuddamu nti, "Ggwe oli muyigiriza wa Isirayiri so n'olwekyo totegeera bintu bino?"

verses.en: Truly, truly, I tell you: we speak what we know, we testify to what we've seen, yet you don't accept our testimony.
verses.tr: Mazima ddala, mazima ddala, nkugamba nti, twogera kye tumanyi, era tutegeeza ku kye twalaba, naye temukkiriza bujulizi bwaffe.

verses.en: If I told you earthly things and you don't believe, how will you believe if I tell you heavenly things?
verses.tr: Obanga mbagambye ebintu eby'oku nsi ne mutakkiriza, munaakkiriza mutya bwe nnaababuulira ebintu eby'omu ggulu?

verses.en: No one has ascended into heaven except the one who descended from heaven, the Son of Man.
verses.tr: Tewali yali alinnye mu ggulu okuggyako oyo eyava mu ggulu, Omwana w'Omuntu.

verses.en: As Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, so the Son of Man must be lifted up,
verses.tr: Era nga Musa bwe yawanika omusota mu ddungu, bw'atyo n'Omwana w'Omuntu kimugwanira okuwanikibwa,

verses.en: that whoever believes in him may have eternal life.
verses.tr: buli amukkiriza alyoke afune obulamu obutaggwaawo.

verses.en: For our Father so loved the world that he gave his one and only Son, that whoever believes in him will not perish but have eternal life.
verses.tr: Kubanga Kitaffe bwe yayagala ennyo ensi, n'awaayo Omwana we omu yekka, buli amukkiriza aleme okuzikirira wabula afune obulamu obutaggwaawo.

verses.en: For our Father did not send his Son into the world to condemn the world, but so the world could be saved through him.
verses.tr: Kubanga Kitaffe teyatuma Omwana we mu nsi okusalira ensi omusango, wabula ensi erokolebwe ku bwe.

verses.en: Whoever believes in him isn't condemned; whoever doesn't believe is condemned already, for not believing in the name of the one and only Son of our Father.
verses.tr: Buli amukkiriza tasalirwa musango, naye atakkiriza amaze okusalirwa omusango, kubanga takkirizza linnya lya Mwana wa Kitaffe omu yekka.

verses.en: This is the judgment: light has entered the world, and people loved darkness more than light because their deeds were evil.
verses.tr: Era guno gwe musango: ekitangaala kijjidde mu nsi, n'abantu ne baagala ekizikiza okusinga ekitangaala kubanga emirimu gyabwe gyali mibi.

verses.en: Everyone who does evil hates the light and won't come to the light, so that his deeds aren't exposed.
verses.tr: Kubanga buli akola ebibi akyawa ekitangaala era tajja eri ekitangaala, ng'atya emirimu gye gireme okwolesebwa.

verses.en: But whoever does the truth comes to the light, so it may be revealed that his works have been done in our Father."
verses.tr: Naye buli akola eby'amazima ajja eri ekitangaala, kiryoke kirabike bulungi nti emirimu gye gikoleddwa mu Kitaffe.

verses.en: After this, Jesus and his disciples went into the Judean countryside, where he stayed with them, baptizing.
verses.tr: Oluvannyuma lw'ebyo, Yesu n'abayigirizwa be ne bagenda mu byalo bya Buyudaaya, era eyo n'asigala nabo nga abatiza.

verses.en: John also baptized at Aenon near Salim, since water was plentiful there, and people came and were baptized,
verses.tr: Yokaana naye yali abatiza mu Enoni okumpi ne Salimu, kubanga amazzi gaali mangi eyo, n'abantu ne bajja ne babatizibwa,

verses.en: for John had not yet been put in prison.
verses.tr: kubanga Yokaana yali tannateekebwa mu kkomera.

verses.en: Now a discussion arose between some of John's disciples and a Jew over purification.
verses.tr: Awo ne wabaawo empaka wakati w'abamu ku bayigirizwa ba Yokaana n'Omuyudaaya ku by'okulongoosa.

verses.en: They came to John and said, "Rabbi, the man with you beyond the Jordan, the one you testified about—he's baptizing, and everyone goes to him."
verses.tr: Ne bajja eri Yokaana ne bamugamba nti, "Labbi, oyo eyali naawe emitala wa Yoludaani, gwe wakakasa—laba, abatiza, era bonna bagenda gy'ali."

verses.en: John replied, "A person cannot receive even one thing unless it is given him from heaven.
verses.tr: Yokaana n'addamu nti, "Omuntu tayinza kufuna n'ekintu kimu wabula nga kimuweereddwa okuva mu ggulu."

verses.en: You yourselves can testify: I said 'I'm not the Christ, but sent ahead of him.'
verses.tr: Mmwe mwennyini muyinza okutegeeza nti nnagamba nti, 'Nze siri Kristo, naye ntumiddwa okumukulembera.'

verses.en: The one with the bride is the bridegroom—Jesus. The bridegroom's friend, who stands and hears him, rejoices greatly at the bridegroom's voice. So my joy is now complete.
verses.tr: Oyo alina omugole omukazi ye mugole omusajja—Yesu. Munne w'omugole omusajja, ayimirira n'amuwulira, asanyuka nnyo olw'eddoboozi ly'omugole omusajja. Noolwekyo essanyu lyange lino kaakano lituukiridde.

verses.en: He must increase, but I must decrease."
verses.tr: Ye kimugwanira okweyongera, naye nze kindigwanira okukendeera.

verses.en: The one who comes from above is above all. The one from earth belongs to earth and speaks in an earthly way. The one who comes from heaven is above all.
verses.tr: Oyo ava waggulu asinga byonna. Oyo ow'oku nsi wa nsi era ayogera mu ngeri ey'ensi. Oyo ava mu ggulu asinga byonna.

verses.en: He bears witness to what he has seen and heard, yet no one receives his testimony.
verses.tr: Ategeeza ku kye yalaba n'okuwulira, naye tewali akkiriza bujulizi bwe.

verses.en: Whoever receives his testimony confirms that our Father is true.
verses.tr: Buli akkiriza obujulizi bwe akakasa nti Kitaffe wa mazima.

verses.en: The one our Father sent speaks our Father's words, for he gives the Holy Spirit without measure.
verses.tr: Kubanga oyo Kitaffe gw'atumye ayogera ebigambo bya Kitaffe, kubanga awa Omwoyo Omutukuvu awatali kupima.

verses.en: Our Father loves the Son and has given all things into his hand.
verses.tr: Kitaffe ayagala Omwana era awadde byonna mu mukono gwe.

verses.en: Whoever believes in the Son has eternal life; whoever disobeys the Son won't see life—our Father's wrath remains on him.
verses.tr: Buli akkiriza Omwana alina obulamu obutaggwaawo; naye atagondera Mwana taliraba bulamu, wabula obusungu bwa Kitaffe bubeera ku ye.
